children: Anthropic faces challenges in maintaining its high valuation despite a successful debut, Saxo Markets' Charu Chanana says in a research note. "The stock's retreat from its opening highs and further weakness after hours suggest investors are already distinguishing between excitement around AI and the economics of delivering it," the chief investment strategist says. Anthropic's pricing power may not be durable, she says. Token prices are falling as competition intensifies, which creates a "potentially uncomfortable mismatch between revenues that depend on usage and pricing, and infrastructure costs committed years in advance," she says. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
